body:
Photographs from the “Biodiversity of River Neretva” seminar, held at Hotel Mostar in Mostar, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 30 June 2021, within the EXCHANGE project.

Organised by the Tourist Board of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton, the seminar brought together tourism guides, institutional representatives and project partners. Sessions explored the river basin’s biological characteristics, flora, fauna and fish diversity, connecting ecological knowledge with opportunities for visitor interpretation and sustainable tourism.

The photographs document my presentation and participation, alongside moments from the seminar and its audience. The event encouraged knowledge exchange and cooperation around presenting the Neretva’s natural heritage to visitors.
